title: Starfish Prime / Bluegill Triple Prime EMP

tellings.quote: Bluegill Triple Prime was four years before where we incidentally created an EMP in the Starfish Prime series.

plain: In 1962 the United States set off nuclear bombs high above the Pacific in a test series called Starfish Prime, and in doing so accidentally created an EMP, an electromagnetic pulse, a burst of energy that can knock out electronics. Michels says this himself during a debate with a skeptic, naming one of those tests, Bluegill Triple Prime, as coming four years before the events he was discussing. He raises it to tie nuclear testing to what came after.
